_comment: Canonical listing store. Statuses reflect VERIFICATION state, not desirability. A listing may only be status 'match' when its active status was read from a live listing page (see README 'Verification gate'). Search-engine snippets are NOT a valid source of listing status.

dataQuality.source: Redfin live listing pages (www.redfin.com), reachable from this environment as of 2026-09-19. Each match below was read off its own detail page: 'For Sale' status, MLS number, beds, baths, lot size in square feet, and an explicit 'Has Private Pool: Yes' amenity record. Three of the five were independently re-confirmed as active, at the same price and bed/bath count, against Coldwell Banker's MetroList IDX feed (coldwellbankerhomes.com).
dataQuality.coverage: Every active single-family listing in Shingle Springs, Rescue and Placerville meeting 4+ bd / 3+ ba / <= $1.5M was enumerated (37 cards in 95682, 24 in 95672, 21 in 95667) and each in-city result was opened individually to read lot size and pool status. The lot-size filter was deliberately dropped for this sweep so that listings with missing acreage data could not hide. 19 homes cleared beds/baths/acreage/price; 5 of those have a pool.
dataQuality.note: The 2026-07-26 run reported 4 properties as matches and all 4 were off market, because status was inferred from search-result text. That failure mode is now closed: status comes from the live listing page, not from a search snippet.

runLog.note: First run with live listing-page access. All 5 matches are new. 6 unverifiable records from the 2026-07-26 run were dropped after confirming none appear in current active inventory. Bedroom minimum relaxed from 5+ to 4+ per the updated brief.
No verified results; 4 reported matches were retracted.

listings.blurb: Cheapest pool property on the list and the only one that has already moved on price — cut $60,000 on 16 Sep, three days before this run. Two-storey main house on 5 acres with a ground-level guest suite that has its own entrance and full bath, plus a full basement and two-car garage. The trade-off is size: at 2,155 sq ft it is by far the smallest house here, and at 1962 it is the oldest. Priced at $413/sq ft against $949,000 asked three weeks ago.
listings.notes: Verified active on Redfin 2026-09-19. Pool confirmed via MLS amenity record (Has Private Pool: Yes). Price history read from the listing's own event table: Listed 2026-08-27 at $949,000, price changed 2026-09-16 to $889,000. A web-search snippet still reports the old $949,000 figure - the live page is authoritative.

listings.broker: eXp Realty of Northern California, Inc.
listings.blurb: The only Rescue property that qualifies. End-of-road position on 5.86 park-like acres, with roughly 750 sq ft of finished space above a detached three-car garage — game room plus an extra room and bath — connected to the main house by a covered walkway. That annexe is what makes a 2,506 sq ft house workable. 79 days on market with no price move yet, which is the longest unreduced run on this list.
listings.notes: Verified active on Redfin 2026-09-19 and independently re-confirmed against Coldwell Banker's MetroList IDX: MLS 226083791, 4 bed / 3 bath, $1,175,000, IsActive true. Pool confirmed via MLS amenity record.

listings.blurb: Best balance on the list: 10.11 acres, 3,400 sq ft, pool and spa, at $353/sq ft. Renovated kitchen with quartz counters and stainless appliances opening to a family room with soaring ceilings and a woodstove, plus an upstairs game room with a wet bar. Minutes from town but fully private. 78 days on market without a reduction — and the most-viewed listing here (1,298 Redfin views), so interest exists without a deal yet.
listings.notes: Verified active on Redfin 2026-09-19 and independently re-confirmed against Coldwell Banker's MetroList IDX: MLS 226083864, 4 bed / 3 bath, $1,200,000, IsActive true. Pool and spa confirmed via MLS amenity record.

listings.blurb: The nicest pool of the five: an infinity-edge saltwater pool and spa set to overlook the hillside. Single-storey custom build from 2003 — the newest house on the list — 3,132 sq ft on about 5 private acres, with a four-car garage. Single level and 23 years newer than the Wildwood Lane house, which is most of what the extra $410,000 buys.
listings.notes: Verified active on Redfin 2026-09-19 and independently re-confirmed against Coldwell Banker's MetroList IDX: MLS 226082753, 4 bed / 3 bath, $1,299,000, IsActive true. Pool and spa confirmed via MLS amenity record.

listings.blurb: The outlier, and the one that most rewards the 5-acre preference: 40 acres, four times the next largest parcel. Built in 2005 as the builder's own residence — a European Country-inspired estate, 5,351 sq ft with sweeping Sierra foothill views, and a saltwater pool with its own pool house. At $260/sq ft it is the cheapest per square foot of the five despite the highest asking price. 94 days on market with no reduction, which on a property this specific is not surprising, but it does suggest room to negotiate.
listings.notes: Verified active on Redfin 2026-09-19. Pool and pool house confirmed via MLS amenity record. Note the Redfin URL slug reads 'Sagittarius-Rd' while the listing address is 'Sagittarius Dr'; same property, MLS 226064449. Not found in the Coldwell Banker IDX pages fetched, so this one rests on the Redfin live page alone.

nearMisses._comment: Active listings that clear 4+ bd, 3+ ba, 2.5+ acres and <= $1.5M in the three target cities but have NO pool. Kept because they show where the market sits and because a pool is addable; not presented as matches.
